locodosy_native.py is a byte-for-byte copy of the existing Python translation
from diffusion-inversion/python/src/diffusion_inversion/locodosy_native.py.
The source module contains its original attribution and GPL-3.0-or-later
translation notice. The GNAT distribution's GPLv3 license is included in
COPYING-GNAT. Original MATLAB copyright: Mathias Nilsson (2007, 2010, 2017).

This is an attributed comparator implementing existing SCORE / LOCODOSY
methodology, not a new inversion method of the present manuscript. The common
acquisition-CV wrapper and the explicitly labeled SCORE-NNLS-CV variant are
defined separately in run_experimental.py and score_nnls_cv.py.

The experimental calculations originally imported this same module from the
local diffusion-inversion checkout. It was then frozen here, with identical
SHA-256, to remove an absolute path dependency for replay. No scientific source
code in the copied module was changed.
